readout_other: von Frey mechanical thresholds; elevated plus maze; c-Fos/Vglut2/GABA immunofluorescence; H&E; TUNEL
direction_notes: LIFU reduced NTG-induced c-Fos hyperactivation in the prelimbic mPFC, reduced activated glutamatergic and increased activated GABAergic neurons, and reversed allodynia and anxiety-like behaviour.
safety_notes: HE and TUNEL staining of the mPFC (n = 3 per group) showed no differences in tissue morphology or apoptosis; locomotor distance was unchanged.

timing.protocol_description: Isppa not given; Ispta 600 mW/cm2, PRF 2 kHz, sonication duration 0.05 s, inter-stimulation interval 2 s, duty cycle 60%, tone-burst duration 0.3 ms. LIFU began 20 min after NTG injection under 0.5% isoflurane; the number or total duration of stimulations is not stated.

flags.reason: 9 mice per group in the behavioural cohort (NTG+LIFU); separate cohorts of 6 per group (immunofluorescence) and 3 per group (histology) were also used, total exposed not stated
Ispta 600 mW/cm2 stated without saying whether free field or in situ
Tone-burst duration 0.3 ms is stated; it is consistent with duty cycle / PRF
No auditory control used; authors argue 0.5 MHz lies outside the mouse hearing range
Paper states quantitative analyses were blinded and describes the histology as double-blind; blinding level of the stimulation itself is unclear
Sham is anaesthesia and positioning without ultrasonic output; no VEH+LIFU group
